# Joinstick

> Turn phones into gamepads for browser games. The game page (host) shows one QR code per player slot; scanning it opens a controller page on the phone. Self-hosted Node server (`npx joinstick`), plain ESM browser SDKs, JSON over WebSocket.

Full guide: AGENTS.md. Wire format: PROTOCOL.md. Types: /joinstick/host.d.ts, /joinstick/client.d.ts (all in the npm package and at https://github.com/raprav/joinstick).

## Run

`npx joinstick --static ./my-game` serves the game and Joinstick on http://localhost:3000 (or `npm i joinstick`, then `npx joinstick`). Node 22+. Phones must be on the same Wi-Fi. Flags: `--port` (PORT, default 3000), `--static <dir>`, `--public-url <url>` (PUBLIC_URL; base URL phones open, an origin without a path, for tunnels/Docker/proxies), `--client-ip-header <name>` (CLIENT_IP_HEADER; behind a trusted proxy, the header with the visitor's address for the per-address limits).

## Integrate

```js
import { host } from '/joinstick/host.js';
const room = await host({ slots: 2, layout: { stick: 'dpad', buttons: [{ id: 'a', label: 'A' }, { id: 'b', label: 'B' }] } });
// show <img src={room.qr()}> and the text room.joinUrl(): each phone that scans it gets the first free slot (room.qr(n) for a fixed slot)
function tick() {
  for (let n = 1; n <= room.slots; n++) {
    const { x, y, buttons, pressed } = room.input(n); // once per frame per slot
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(tick);
}
tick();
```

If host.js is bundled or the game is served from another origin: `import { host } from 'joinstick/host'` (package installed from git or a checkout) and pass `server: 'http://<host>:3000'`.

## Input contract

- Slots are 1-based. `room.input(0)` throws RangeError.
- `room.input(n)` is never undefined: `{ x, y, buttons, pressed }`. Neutral when the slot is empty and after leave. After a join or game reload, input already held shows in x/y/buttons but never in pressed.
- `x`: -1 left .. 1 right. `y`: -1 up .. 1 down. The d-pad gives -1/0/1 (8-way; up needs the thumb clearly above horizontal).
- `buttons`: held state of every layout button. Use for movement, block, charge.
- `pressed`: buttons that went down since the previous `input(n)` call, latched and cleared on read. Use for attacks, jumps, confirm. Never use held state to trigger one-shot actions.
- No input events: polling is the only way to read input.
- Keep calling input(n) every frame while paused (ignore the result), or presses made during the pause fire on resume.

## Pause recipe

```js
const paused = ![1, 2].every((n) => room.connected(n)); // every frame: simplest and always right
room.on('leave', ({ slot, reason }) => pause(slot));     // reason: left | disconnected | timeout | kicked
room.on('join', ({ slot, name, rejoin }) => maybeResume());
```

A locked/backgrounded phone leaves immediately and rejoins its slot when back (join with rejoin: true). Game page reload: host() resumes the same room; pads already connected are visible via connected(n) when host() resolves and get NO join event, so check connected(n) at start; held input is restored; every pad's state (title/color/highlight/disabled) is reset. Host Wi-Fi blip: leave (disconnected) for all, then join with rejoin: true. Server restart: same room code; phones rejoin with rejoin: false. A stored room is only resumed with the same slots count. A duplicated browser tab takes over the room: the original gets room.on('error') with code 'replaced' and status 'closed'.

## Layout

`{ stick: 'dpad' | 'none', orientation?: 'landscape' (default) | 'portrait' | 'any', arrangement?: 'grid' (default) | 'diamond' | 'arc', haptics?: true, buttons: [{ id, label?, color?, size?: 'large' | 'wide', haptic?: ms 0-100, system?: true }] }`, max 8 buttons (system ones included). id `/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,16}$/` unique, not an Object.prototype name (constructor, toString...); label ≤ 8 chars; color `/^#[0-9a-f]{3,8}$/i`. Default: d-pad + a, b. Invalid layout → host() rejects with code 'bad-message'.
- orientation 'landscape': a phone held upright shows the pad rotated 90° (works with the rotation lock on); Android Chrome also goes fullscreen and locks the orientation on the first tap.
- arrangement: 'diamond' = first 4 buttons as face buttons (bottom, left, right, top), the rest beside them; 'arc' = first button big under the right thumb, the rest fanned around it.
- size 'wide': a long bar under the other buttons (good for a held action like block).
- system: true renders a small pill in the pad's top bar (START/MENU); it reports in input(n).buttons/pressed like any other button.
- haptics: local tap feedback on press and d-pad direction change (Android: vibrate; iOS 18+: best-effort system tick; desktop: none). layout.haptics false turns it off; per-button haptic sets ms (0 = off).

## Host API

room.code, room.slots, room.status ('connecting'|'connected'|'reconnecting'|'closed'), room.input(n), room.connected(n), room.qr(n?), room.joinUrl(n?) (no n: first free slot), room.pad(n, { title?, color?, highlight?: ids (glow and make the phone vibrate briefly (Android only); disabled wins over highlight), disabled?: ids, vibrate?: ms }), room.kick(n), room.send(n, data), room.broadcast(data), room.on('join'|'leave'|'message'|'status'|'error', fn) → unsubscribe, room.close().

## Client API (custom controllers, remote players)

```js
import { join } from '/joinstick/client.js';
const pad = await join({ room: 'KQZX', slot: 1, name: 'Ana' }); // slot omitted = first free
pad.setInput({ x, y, buttons: { a: true } }); pad.send(data); pad.on('message'|'pad'|'error'|'status', fn); pad.leave();
```

## Error codes

room-not-found, slot-taken (with free: [slots]), bad-slot, bad-message (with message), replaced, kicked, room-closed (host gone 60 s), version, server-full (1000 rooms, or 20 from one address), rate-limited (20 failed joins from one address in a minute); client-only: unreachable.

## Pitfalls

- First run: allow Node through the OS firewall prompt.
- Guest/hotel Wi-Fi with client isolation blocks phones: use a hotspot or a tunnel.
- Plain HTTP: no wake lock, no iOS fullscreen. Host-driven vibrate (room.pad vibrate/highlight) works only on Android.
- An HTTPS game page cannot reach a ws:// LAN server (mixed content): serve the game with --static or put both behind HTTPS.
- Docker breaks LAN IP detection: use --public-url.
- Remote play: `cloudflared tunnel --url http://localhost:3000`, then start Joinstick with `--public-url https://<name>.trycloudflare.com`. 4-letter room codes are guessable on a public URL; there is no other authentication.
- --static refuses dotfiles and has no HTTP Range support (Safari video/audio needs Range: serve media elsewhere).
- Embedding with attach(server): call it after registering your own 'request' listeners.
- A pad in a background browser tab leaves its slot (lock-screen behavior).

## Testing without phones

In the game tab's console (or a Node 22+ script importing joinstick/public/client.js with `server: 'http://localhost:3000'`):

```js
const { join } = await import('/joinstick/client.js');
const pad = await join({ room: room.code, slot: 1 });
pad.setInput({ x: 1 });                         // hold right
pad.setInput({ x: 1, buttons: { a: true } });   // press A
pad.setInput({ x: 1, buttons: { a: false } });  // release: input(1).pressed.a seen once
pad.leave();                                    // game should pause
```

## Don't

- Don't use innerHTML with player names or network data; use textContent.
- Don't read held state for one-shot actions; use pressed.
- Don't call input(n) twice per frame for the same slot.
